{{Current events|year=2019|month=05|day=25|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->

;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Saudi Arabia–United States relations]], [[Iran–Saudi Arabia relations]], [[Iran–Saudi Arabia proxy conflict]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] bypasses Congress to approve the sale of billions of dollars' worth of weapons to [[Saudi Arabia]], citing Iranian threats against the latter. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-48404923 (BBC)]

;Arts and culture
*[[2019 Cannes Film Festival]]
**The South Korean film ''[[Parasite (2019_film)|Parasite]]'' wins the 2019 [[Palme d'Or]], the Cannes Film Festival's top prize. [https://www.cnn.com/style/article/cannes-2019-festival-highlights/index.html (CNN)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Tornadoes of 2019]]
**Two people are killed and several are missing due to a tornado in the U.S. state of [[Oklahoma]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/dead-unknown-number-missing-tornado-hits-el-reno/story?id=63283969 (ABC News)]
*A boat sinking on [[Lake Mai-Ndombe]] in western [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] kills at least 45 people with 200 passengers still missing. The  vessel was carrying more than 400 people, the  majority of whom were teachers going to collect their salaries. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-48421344 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 European Parliament election]]
**Citizens in [[2019 European Parliament election in Latvia|Latvia]], [[2019 European Parliament election in Malta|Malta]], [[2019 European Parliament election in Slovakia|Slovakia]] and the [[2019 European Parliament election in France|French]] [[Overseas France|overseas territories]] head to the polls to vote in the latest [[European Parliament]] election. Additionally, voting in the [[2019 European Parliament election in the Czech Republic|Czech Republic]] continues for the second day. [http://www.europarl.europa.eu/at-your-service/en/be-heard/elections (European Parliament)]
*Hundreds of counter-protesters show up and protest against an estimated nine attendees of a planned rally by a [[Ku Klux Klan]]-affiliated group in [[Dayton, Ohio]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/dayton-ohio-kkk-rally-hundreds-of-counter-protesters-demonstrate-today-2019-05-25/ (CBS News)]

;Science and technology
*Binary [[Aten asteroid]] [[(66391) 1999 KW4]] and its [[minor-planet moon]] make their closest-ever recorded flyby of [[Earth]] at 3.2 million miles away. The asteroid will approach even closer at 0.0155 AU (2,320,000 km) from Earth in [[2036]], and is the largest asteroid to approach Earth until [[(4953) 1990 MU]] in June 2027. [https://www.newsweek.com/1999-kw4-asteroid-tiny-moon-close-approach-earth-weekend-1435071 (Newsweek)]

;Sports
*[[2019 NBA playoffs]]
**The [[Toronto Raptors]] defeat the [[Milwaukee Bucks]] in Game 6 and advance to the [[2019 NBA Finals|NBA Finals]] for the first time in the team's history. [https://www.cbc.ca/amp/1.5150142 (CBC)] [https://amp.si.com/nba/2019/05/25/raptors-bucks-kawhi-leonard-nba-finals-eastern-conference-finals (Sports Illustrated)]
